summary: All three S2 reorder holes promoted to full anchors with their own start_chapters; no zone-level fallbacks needed. Eps 18-20 turn out to air chapters IN book order (chs 21-24, vol 5) — the S2 reorder crossing is confined to eps 14-16 (26, 13+19, 16+14), and eps 17-21 run monotonically through chs 20-25. Ep 18 'Cytokines' is the one split: fandom's ch-21 reverse map reads 'Episodes 17-18', matching the stored ep 17 anchor's '{20, 21 (start)}' — ep 17's Antigenic Shift segment ends at NK Cell's arrival, and ep 18 opens with the substantial back half of ch 21 (influenza outbreak, antigenic-shift mutation, Dendritic Cell setup) before adapting all of ch 22, so its own start is 21, not 22. Eps 19 and 20 are clean single-chapter title-match episodes (ch 23 'Harmful Bacteria', ch 24 'Cancer Cell II (Part I)'). One consequence for stored data: ep 17 ends mid-ch 21 but has no stored continue point, so the derived end+1=22 skips the unread back half of 21 — added continue_points entry ep17→21. Chapter-side reverse maps also re-confirm the stored ep 21 anchor (ch 25 → Episode 21) and its continue→27 (chs 27-29 + vol-6 Special 'Psoriasis' carry no |anime= field, i.e. never adapted; ch 26 was ep 14).

anchors.note: Ep 18 (S2 ep 5) 'Cytokines' = ch 22 by identical title (サイトカイン, vol 5); opens by finishing the back half of ch 21 'Antigenic Shift' — fandom Chapter 21 infobox maps it to 'Episodes 17-18', and ep 17's plot ends the Antigenic Shift segment exactly at NK Cell's arrival, leaving the influenza outbreak/mutation and Dendritic Cell setup (a substantial share, not tail pages) to ep 18. Fandom Chapter 22 reverse map |anime=Episode 18; Wikipedia vol 5 = chs 20-25 with matching titles. No page splits stated anywhere.

Ep 19 (S2 ep 6) 'Harmful Bacteria' = ch 23 by identical title (悪玉菌, vol 5); single-chapter episode. Fandom Chapter 23 reverse map |anime=Episode 19; Wikipedia chapter list vol 5. The closing cliffhanger (real Cancer Cell wins, high-heels sound = Regulatory T's arrival) may borrow ch 24's opening page or two as a sliver — both reverse maps keep 23→19 and 24→20, so it stays out of the chapter numbers.

Ep 20 (S2 ep 7) 'Cancer Cell II (Part I)' = ch 24 by identical title (がん細胞２（前編）, vol 5); single-chapter episode, plot beats match (Regulatory T defends Cancer Cell, Normal Cell cornered, U-1146 podded). Fandom Chapter 24 reverse map |anime=Episode 20; Wikipedia chapter list vol 5. Continue is natural end+1=25 (ep 21).

continue_points.note: NOT a target ep, but its stored anchor (end 21, {20, 21 (start)}) has no continue point, so end+1=22 is derived — dishonest here: ep 17 ends mid-ch 21 (at NK Cell's arrival; fandom Chapter 21 maps to Episodes 17-18), so the honest resume is ch 21 itself.

flags_for_sean: Eps 17-21 air chs 20-25 in straight book order — the S2 reorder is only eps 14-16. If the reorder-crossing detector flagged 18-20 because of the 14-16 crossing plus missing rows, these anchors close it; no rearranged annotation is warranted for 18-20.
